case_for_it: Densest cluster of JCI hospitals outside the metros. Aster and VPS groups also run hospitals in the UAE.
watch_out: Monsoon June to September. Book recovery stays away from the busiest wards.

case_for_it: KIMSHEALTH is heavily used by Gulf patients and runs hospitals in Oman, Bahrain and Qatar.
watch_out: Beyond KIMS, accreditation of other hospitals is unconfirmed.

case_for_it: Ganga Hospital for bone, joint and spine. PSG holds JCI Prime certification. GEM for GI and bariatric surgery.
watch_out: Check direct flights. Some routes connect via other cities.

case_for_it: Two JCI hospitals with international wings. Serves the Gujarati diaspora in the Gulf.
watch_out: Summer heat. Two of four hospitals need accreditation checks.
